Resin to FDM conversion

Resin supports are too thin for a 0.2mm or 0.4mm nozzle. The Resin2FDM workflow splits the miniature from its supports, thickens those supports to roughly 0.05–0.2mm, then exports both parts so your slicer can print the supports at faster, coarse settings.

If you only have an FDM printer but the model you want is sold pre-supported for resin, you do not have to give up on it. I walk through the Blender add-on, the numbers that matter and the failure modes I hit, so you can decide whether a model is worth converting at all.
